 Radio show: IU football coach Curt Cignetti recaps OSU game, previews Michigan
 By TDH Staff October 22, 2026 
 IU Football 
 No Comments 
 Share 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 LinkedIn 
 Pinterest 
 Email 
 Tune in as IU football coach Curt Cignetti joined legendary radio voice Don Fischer on their Inside Indiana Football show.
 The pair recapped the loss to Ohio State and looked ahead to this weekend’s game at Michigan.
 Edge rusher Tobi Osunsanmi joined Fischer in the final segement.
 No. 6 Indiana (6-1) takes on Michigan (4-2) Saturday at Noon ET in Ann Arbor (FOX).
 Video via IU Athletics on YouTube.
